deferred_details.detail: OIDC vendor configuration, API credential provisioning/rotation UX, storage multipart provider details and production cookie domain selected in implementation ADRs.

Claim/evidence creation and reclassification commands, advanced comments/diff/restore and recipe/persona library management are represented by typed snapshots but their additional CRUD routes must be frozen before corresponding UI.
Avatar/voice/media consent administration and provider-specific callback payloads require provider authority and lifecycle review; no invented callback security shape.
OAuth error callback query variants, platform native payloads/limits and callback routes are adapter-specific contracts; no provider tokens in public domain schemas.
Operational backup/provider-deletion exceptions and retention policies require owner validation. Workspace export/download token behavior is design only.
Public signup, subscription checkout, invoices and payment lifecycle require separate R2 commercial contract.
